delete.description: 409 code: OUTLINE_NODE_HAS_CHILDREN — reparent or delete the children first, so a subtree can never be orphaned by one click.

put.description: Edits stem, explanation and difficulty of a DRAFT question only. A PUBLISHED, ARCHIVED or REJECTED question answers 409 with `code: QUESTION_NOT_EDITABLE`: published questions are already quoted by exam/practice snapshots and by mastery and diagnosis rows, so editing them would change what an existing paper grades against. Publish and archive are the verbs for a published question.

404.description: No such question in this space (`code: NOT_FOUND`)

409.description: `code: QUESTION_NOT_EDITABLE` — the question is not a DRAFT

put.description: ADMIN grade of one subjective (SHORT_ANSWER) answer of any learner in this space. The score is stored and result/diagnosis/mastery are recomputed from it; grading the same answer again corrects it, and the first score and feedback stay in previousScore/previousFeedback.

get.summary: Get my AI provider settings (never returns the API key)

put.summary: Update my AI provider settings; omit apiKey to keep the stored secret

put.description: ADMIN manual grade of one subjective answer. The score is stored and result/diagnosis/mastery are recomputed from it, and grading_status only reaches GRADED once no stored subjective answer awaits a score. 400 when the score is outside 0..slot maxScore; 404 `code: EXAM_ANSWER_NOT_FOUND`; 409 `code: EXAM_ANSWER_NOT_SUBJECTIVE` for an objective slot, `code: EXAM_GRADING_INCOMPLETE`/`code: EXAM_RESULT_NOT_AVAILABLE` for the attempt state.

post.description: 409 code: STUDY_TASK_REORDER_FAILED when a listed task is no longer in the plan.
409 codes: STUDY_PLAN_COMPLETED (a finished plan is kept for the record), STUDY_PLAN_NO_CANDIDATES.
409 codes: STUDY_TASK_NOT_SKIPPED, STUDY_TASK_STALE.
409 codes: STUDY_TASK_ALREADY_CLOSED, STUDY_TASK_STALE.
409 codes: STUDY_TASK_SKIPPED_NOT_COMPLETABLE, STUDY_TASK_ALREADY_CLOSED, STUDY_TASK_STALE (another request moved the task first).
Builds a plan from pending review tasks and mastery evidence. 409 codes: STUDY_PLAN_ACTIVE_EXISTS (this space already has an ACTIVE plan), STUDY_PLAN_NO_CANDIDATES (nothing to plan yet).

Uploads one entry of an awaited snapshot. Conflicts answer 409 with a stable `code`: FOLDER_SNAPSHOT_ALREADY_PROCESSED, FOLDER_SNAPSHOT_NOT_AWAITING_UPLOADS, FOLDER_ENTRY_ALREADY_LINKED, FOLDER_ENTRY_NOT_PENDING, FOLDER_ENTRY_CHECKSUM_MISMATCH, FOLDER_ENTRY_STALE. A checksum mismatch means the bytes are not what the snapshot declared; FOLDER_ENTRY_STALE means another request already moved that entry.

Closes the snapshot once every entry is resolved. Conflicts answer 409 with a stable `code`: FOLDER_SNAPSHOT_ALREADY_PROCESSED, FOLDER_SNAPSHOT_NOT_AWAITING_UPLOADS, FOLDER_ENTRY_ALREADY_LINKED, FOLDER_ENTRY_NOT_PENDING, FOLDER_ENTRY_CHECKSUM_MISMATCH, FOLDER_ENTRY_STALE.

Binds already-uploaded assets to snapshot entries. Conflicts answer 409 with a stable `code`: FOLDER_SNAPSHOT_ALREADY_PROCESSED, FOLDER_SNAPSHOT_NOT_AWAITING_UPLOADS, FOLDER_ENTRY_ALREADY_LINKED, FOLDER_ENTRY_NOT_PENDING, FOLDER_ENTRY_CHECKSUM_MISMATCH, FOLDER_ENTRY_STALE.

Closes the session and stores the summary in the same transaction. 409 `code: PRACTICE_SESSION_NOT_IN_PROGRESS` when it is not open, `code: PRACTICE_SESSION_STALE` when another request moved it on first.
Grades one answer immediately and stores it. 409 codes: PRACTICE_SESSION_NOT_IN_PROGRESS (the session is not open), PRACTICE_ANSWER_STALE.
409 code: KP_RELATION_CYCLE when the new edge would close a cycle in the graph.
Starts an attempt. 409 `code: EXAM_ACTIVE_ATTEMPT_EXISTS` when the learner already has an unfinished attempt on this paper.

Builds the paper from the blueprint's distributions. 409 `code: EXAM_BLUEPRINT_UNSATISFIED` when the question pool cannot meet the declared type/difficulty quotas or the total: the distributions are enforced, so a paper is never silently produced with a different shape (or a shorter length) than the blueprint that was reviewed. 409 `code: EXAM_BLUEPRINT_NOT_DRAFT` when the blueprint has already generated a paper.
Submits and grades in one transaction. 409 `code: EXAM_ATTEMPT_ALREADY_SUBMITTED` on a second submit, `code: EXAM_RESULT_NOT_AVAILABLE` when grading produced no result row.

Saves one answer against the paper's frozen snapshot. Every rejection names a code: EXAM_ATTEMPT_NOT_IN_PROGRESS, EXAM_DEADLINE_EXCEEDED, EXAM_ANSWER_STALE (another request rewrote this answer), EXAM_ANSWER_NOT_GRADABLE.

post.description: 409 codes: AI_JOB_NOT_RETRYABLE (only FAILED jobs are retried), AI_JOB_STALE.

get.description: Paged conversations, newest activity first: ORDER BY COALESCE(last_message_at, created_at) DESC, id DESC. Page numbers are 0-based.

get.description: Paged messages of one conversation, OLDEST first: ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC, so page 0 is the beginning of the thread and the newest page is totalPages-1. The UI renders a chat transcript by appending later pages, not by reading page 0 as the latest.

200.description: message page in ascending time order

post.summary: Send a user message and receive the AI tutor reply
post.description: Optional sourceId / sourcePageId / contentBlockId / knowledgePointId pin the material the question is about. Only IDs are accepted: the server resolves them against this LearningSpace (unknown, foreign-space or soft-deleted IDs are a 400 VALIDATION_ERROR), retrieves the material itself, and lets the pinned material take precedence over automatic retrieval. 409 `code: AI_CONVERSATION_NOT_ACTIVE` when the conversation is archived.

post.summary: Archive one of my AI conversations
Test my provider connectivity from the backend

post.description: Requires a SUBMITTED practice session, else 409 `code: VARIANT_SESSION_NOT_SUBMITTED`. The generated variant is stored as a DRAFT and never published automatically.
409 code: MASTERY_CALIBRATION_VERSION_EXISTS when that version is already stored.

Recomputes the attempt result from the stored grades and returns the verdict. 409 `code: EXAM_GRADING_INCOMPLETE` while a subjective answer still awaits a score; `code: EXAM_RESULT_NOT_AVAILABLE` before submit.

Suggested score and rationale for one subjective answer, produced by the configured AI provider. Advisory only: nothing is written, final_score is always false, and a score outside 0..maxScore is clamped with clamped=true. 404 `code: EXAM_ANSWER_NOT_FOUND`; 409 `code: AI_GRADING_SUGGESTION_NOT_AVAILABLE` for a non-subjective slot or an unusable model response; 502 `code: AI_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE`.

get.description: Keyword search scoped to ONE LearningSpace. Search indexes safe user-visible text such as source title, content block text, knowledge point title/summary/content, question stem and wrong-question stems, plus the caller's own note titles and bodies. Only user-visible content is returned: SOURCE, CONTENT_BLOCK, KNOWLEDGE_POINT and QUESTION rows must be PUBLISHED, page and block rows must additionally belong to the source's current extraction revision (rows predating revision ownership stay visible), and NOTE / WRONG_QUESTION are scoped to the caller. Ranking combines the deterministic LIKE tiers with the MySQL ngram FULLTEXT relevance score, falling back to LIKE alone for queries FULLTEXT cannot tokenize. A NOTE hit carries noteId so the client can open it directly. Space isolation is enforced at the SQL level.

400.description: Invalid query, type, page or size

get.description: Score summary written at submit time. 409 `code: PRACTICE_SESSION_NOT_SUBMITTED` while the session is still open — zeros would be a fabricated score — and `code: PRACTICE_RESULT_NOT_RECORDED` for a session submitted before results were stored.
Reads the stored result. 409 `code: EXAM_RESULT_NOT_AVAILABLE` while the attempt is not submitted, `code: EXAM_RESULT_MISSING` when a submitted attempt has no result row to show.

409 codes: EXAM_DIAGNOSIS_NOT_AVAILABLE while the attempt is not submitted, EXAM_DIAGNOSIS_MISSING when a submitted attempt has no diagnosis rows to show (an empty card must never read as 'no weak points').

get.summary: Get one of my AI conversations

get.description: Answers of one attempt as a grader sees them. 404 `code: EXAM_NOT_FOUND` when the exam is unknown, `code: EXAM_ANSWER_NOT_FOUND` for an attempt that is not part of it.

questionType.description: Answer shape the `answer` and `options` fields follow.

status.description: Lifecycle state. Only DRAFT is editable (PUT answers 409 QUESTION_NOT_EDITABLE otherwise).

UpdateAiProviderSettingsRequest.description: Write-only update. Omit apiKey to keep the stored secret.

questionType.description: Authoring type. ORDERING carries options to be put in a 1-based order; MATCHING carries `matches` as a JSON array of {left,right} pair objects.

finalScore.description: Always false: this is advice. The score is only stored once an ADMIN posts it to the grading endpoint.

gradingStatus.description: Grading state of the attempt, null while it is still open. GRADED is final; PARTIALLY_GRADED means the objective part is scored while some answers still await a human grade.
